## Summary

Describe the detection, telemetry, documentation, or tooling change.

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `mypy soc_lab parsers detection_engine`
- [ ] `python -m soc_lab validate`

## Safety and scope

- [ ] This change stays local and authorized.
- [ ] This change adds no credentials, sensitive logs, personal data, or external targets.
- [ ] ATT&CK mapping, tests, Sigma intent, and runbook are updated where applicable.
